datasets.purpose: Primary Model 1 dataset: written text with binary Big Five labels.
datasets.source: Original stream-of-consciousness Essays corpus; the precise distributor of this local CSV has not yet been verified.
datasets.citation: Pennebaker, J. W., & King, L. A. (1999). Linguistic styles: Language use as an individual difference. Journal of Personality and Social Psychology, 77(6), 1296–1312. https://doi.org/10.1037/0022-3514.77.6.1296
datasets.notes: The original corpus citation is recorded. Verify the precise upstream distributor, applicable licence, download date and version of this local 2,467-row CSV before analysis or redistribution.

datasets.purpose: Emotion-recognition support dataset for Model 1; not a Big Five target dataset.
datasets.citation: Demszky et al. (2020), GoEmotions: A Dataset of Fine-Grained Emotions.
datasets.version: full_dataset CSV shards plus official agreement-filtered split references
datasets.notes: The Google Research repository states that datasets in the repository are released under CC BY 4.0. Preserve attribution to the original paper.

datasets.purpose: Model 2 dataset: BFI-2 domain-scale inputs and BESSI domain-scale soft-skill targets.
datasets.source: Downloaded BFI-2/BESSI college student sample workbook; precise upstream distributor remains to be verified.
datasets.version: BFI-2 and BESSI scores supplied in the downloaded workbook; exact release/version pending verification.
datasets.notes: The workbook has 322 measurement rows. Its Case column is reused across rows with distinct values, so it must not be treated as a unique participant identifier.
